meta.band_rule: within_band = |sim - mean| <= 1.5 * std (std = spread of the season value across the 30 teams), or <= band_half where given

league_notes.pace: possessions per 48 minutes using each team's own estimate; overtime handled via box minutes when plausible.

meta.league_source: data/research/game_boxscores_2025_26.json team box stats (regular season, final games). Player-level FGM/FGA in that cache are 0 (known parser bug), so they are NOT used.
meta.player_keys: universe_2026_27_offseason players[].id; matched by ESPN id, then unique normalized name
meta.player_source: data/research/player_career_stats.json 2025-26 season totals (ESPN); usage/ORB%/DRB% from Player Stats/player_stats.json (Crafted NBA) when the name matches uniquely.
meta.player_usage_note: usage_pct is the source-provided usage rate (BBRef style), not recomputed; it is not part of compare().
meta.possession_formula: FGA + 0.44*FTA - ORB + TOV (team total, tov includes team turnovers)
meta.texture_notes: players_used: players with minutes per team-game; <stat><N>_per_game: player lines with stat >= N per game (count = real season count). Bands: calibration_targets.texture_band.
